name.basis: The firm's own name (site title, read 2026-10-06). The adviser is Founders Fund LLC, CRD 155462.

website.basis: The firm's own site; thefoundersfund.com carried it from 2005 to 2009.

founding_year.basis: The first site is captured in July 2005, with a 2005 copyright line of The Founders Fund Management, LLC and a portfolio page saying the first investments had been placed. Founders: Peter Thiel, Ken Howery, Luke Nosek (the firm's own 2009 meta description names the three as PayPal co-founders).

investment_concept.value: “Founders Fund is a San Francisco based venture capital firm investing in companies building revolutionary technologies.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own line: the homepage meta description (also og:description), read 2026-10-06. The homepage has no headline of its own; its h2 lines are captions of portfolio companies. The 2017 manifesto 'What happened to the future?' carries the better-known line 'We wanted flying cars, instead we got 140 characters'.

history.value: Founders Fund was founded in San Francisco in 2005 by Peter Thiel, Ken Howery and Luke Nosek, who had built PayPal together. It was an early backer of Facebook, SpaceX, Palantir, Airbnb and Stripe, and later of Anduril and OpenAI. In 2026 it closed a $6 billion growth fund, its largest, and its funds held about $59 billion of assets at the end of 2025.
history.basis: Founding: the 2005 site and the firm's 2009 meta description. Bets: each is a portfolio row with its own citation. Growth IV: Form D of 2026 ($6.02B sold; TechCrunch reported the close near $6B on 2026-03-09). Assets: the sum of Item 11 gross asset values of the 48 private funds in Section 7.B of the Form ADV of 2026-03-30 ($58.93B, fiscal year end 2025). Not on the page, kept here: the fund ladder (Funds I to IX, Growth I to IV); 17 deal vehicles and FFAV, LLC on the ADV; the Miami office opened in 2021; Gigafund, Mithril, Valar and Thiel Capital are separate firms and outside this portfolio; public-market and PIPE positions (BitMine, ETHZilla, Opendoor) are outside it.

aum.basis: Both ends sworn: Founders Fund LLC is an exempt reporting adviser (CRD 155462, SEC 802-75555) and files no Item 5.F, so the anchor is the Section 7.B composite: $58,932,317,467 across 48 private funds at the ADV of 2026-03-30 (flagship funds $34.86B, Growth funds $21.50B, deal vehicles and FFAV $2.57B; sources/edgar/adv-7b-roster.json). Gross asset value includes unrealised gains (Fund II alone $6.6B). Press figures for 'assets under management' sit far below it and are not used.

funds.basis: Flagship and Growth funds, newest first, sizes from each fund's own Form D (amount sold; co-issued side funds included where one filing covers them) and from reported sizes for the 2005 and 2007 funds. No accession is asserted on a co-issued filing. Not listed: Entrepreneurs and Principals side funds, the 17 deal vehicles (Founders AND 1 to 6, ANT, OPEN I and II, SPC, Gopher E, Erebor, Mirian, Miruvor, Lembas II and its Series F) and FFAV, LLC. Fund VIII was reported cut and partly rolled into Fund IX in 2023; the filings' own figures are shown.
